{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Dessert|Dessert]]

'''Mocha icing''' is traditionally used to [[Cookbook:Icing|frost]] [[Cookbook:Hot milk cake|hot milk cake]] or other [[Cookbook:Cake|cakes]].

==Ingredients==
* 6 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|Tbsp]] (90 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]]) [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
* 4 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|Tbsp]] (60 ml) [[Cookbook:Cocoa|cocoa]] powder
* 3 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|Tbsp]] (45 ml) strong brewed [[Cookbook:Coffee|coffee]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|Tbsp]] (15 ml) [[Cookbook:Vanilla|vanilla]] extract
* About 2 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]]s (480 ml) icing [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]

==Procedure==
# An hour before baking the cake, take the butter out of the refrigerator to reach room temperature.
# [[Cookbook:Creaming|Cream]] the butter.
# Add the cocoa and liquids alternately. Then. add the sugar alternately with the liquids.
# Stop at spreading consistency even if you have not used all the sugar.
# Spread on a [[Cookbook:Hot milk cake|hot milk cake]] or other cake.
